source: The purpose of this PySpark notebook is to read Service Bus data from the odw_harmonised_db.sb_applications_crowndev_application Delta table and load the transformed data into the odw_harmonised_db.applications_crowndev_application Delta table based on the Crown project business requirements and transformation logic.

from pyspark.sql.types import IntegerType, ArrayType, StructType, StructField
from pyspark.sql import Row
import pyspark.sql.functions as F
from datetime import date,datetime
import time

service_bus_table = "odw_harmonised_db.sb_applications_crowndev_application"
spark_table_final = "odw_harmonised_db.applications_crowndev_application"
primary_key = "id"

start_exec_time = datetime.now()
insert_count = 0
update_count = 0
delete_count = 0
error_message=''

if not error_message:
    try:

        service_bus_data = spark.sql(f"""
            SELECT DISTINCT
                   sb.crowndev_application_id
                  ,sb.id
                  ,CAST(NULL AS INT) AS casework_fact_key
                  ,sb.reference AS caseReference
                  ,sb.createdDate
                  ,sb.updatedDate
                  ,sb.type
                  ,sb.subType
                  ,sb.linkedParentId
                  ,sb.description
                  ,sb.primaryLPACode AS primaryPINSLPACode
                  ,sb.secondaryLPACode AS secondaryPINSLPACode
                  ,sb.hasAgent
                  ,sb.organisations
                  -- Address Dimension Join
                  ,CAST(ad.address_dim_id AS BIGINT) AS site_address_dim_key
                  ,sb.siteAddress[0].line1 AS siteAddressLine1
                  ,sb.siteAddress[0].line2 AS siteAddressLine2
                  ,sb.siteAddress[0].townCity AS siteAddressTownCity
                  ,sb.siteAddress[0].county AS siteAddressCounty
                  ,sb.siteAddress[0].postcode AS siteAddressPostcode
                  ,sb.siteEasting
                  ,sb.siteNorthing
                  ,sb.siteArea
                  ,sb.expectedDateOfSubmission
                  ,sb.applicationStatus
                  ,sb.applicationStage
                  ,sb.nationallyImportant
                  ,sb.nationallyImportantConfirmationDate
                  ,sb.notNationallyImportantEmailSent
                  ,sb.containsDistressingContent
                  ,sb.lpaReference
                  ,sb.category
                  ,sb.isGreenBelt
                  ,sb.healthAndSafetyIssue
                  ,sb.applicationReceivedDate
                  ,sb.applicationReceivedDateEmailSent
                  ,sb.applicationAcceptedDate
                  ,sb.lpaQuestionnaireSentDate
                  ,sb.lpaQuestionnaireReceivedDate
                  ,sb.lpaQuestionnaireReceivedEmailSent
                  ,sb.publishDate
                  ,sb.pressNoticeDate
                  ,sb.neighboursNotifiedByLpaDate
                  ,sb.siteNoticeByLpaDate
                  ,sb.targetDecisionDate
                  ,sb.extendedTargetDecisionDate
                  ,sb.recoveredDate
                  ,sb.recoveredReportSentDate
                  ,sb.withdrawnDate
                  ,sb.decisionDate
                  ,sb.originalDecisionDate
                  ,sb.decisionOutcome
                  ,sb.turnedAwayDate
                  ,sb.representationsPublishDate
                  ,sb.representationsPeriodStartDate
                  ,sb.representationsPeriodEndDate
                  ,sb.inspector1Id
                  ,sb.inspector2Id
                  ,sb.inspector3Id
                  ,sb.assessorInspectorId
                  ,sb.caseOfficerId
                  ,sb.planningOfficerId
                  ,sb.eiaScreening
                  ,sb.eiaScreeningOutcome
                  ,sb.environmentalStatementReceivedDate
                  ,sb.siteIsVisibleFromPublicLand
                  ,sb.procedure
                  ,sb.procedureNotificationDate
                  ,sb.eventDate
                  ,sb.eventPrepDuration
                  ,sb.eventSittingDuration
                  ,sb.eventReportingDuration
                  ,sb.eventVenue
                  ,sb.eventNotificationDate
                  ,sb.eventIssuesReportPublishedDate
                  ,sb.eventStatementsDate
                  ,sb.eventCaseManagementConferenceDate
                  ,sb.eventPreMeetingDate
                  ,sb.eventProofsOfEvidenceDate
                  ,sb.hasApplicationFee
                  ,sb.applicationFee
                  ,sb.applicationFeeReceivedDate
                  ,sb.eligibleForFeeRefund
                  ,sb.applicationFeeRefundAmount
                  ,sb.applicationFeeRefundDate
                  ,sb.siteVisitDate
                  ,sb.cilLiable
                  ,sb.cilAmount
                  ,sb.bngExempt
                  ,sb.hasCostsApplications
                  ,sb.costsApplicationsComment
                  ,sb.environmentalImpactAssessment
                  ,sb.developmentPlan
                  ,sb.rightOfWay
                  ,'crown-dev' AS ODTSourceSystem
                  ,sb.SourceSystemID
                  ,sb.IngestionDate
                  ,sb.message_id
                  ,sb.ValidTo
                  ,sb.RowID
                  ,sb.IsActive

            FROM {service_bus_table} sb

            LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.address_dim ad
                ON sb.siteAddress[0].addressId = ad.SourceSuid and sb.reference=ad.reference
               AND ad.IsActive = 'Y'
        """)
        service_bus_data.createOrReplaceTempView("vw_applications")

    except Exception as e:
        error_message = (
            f"Error extracting contact fields: {str(e)[:800]}"
        )
        end_exec_time = datetime.now()
        print(error_message)

                ,eventStatementsDate
                ,eventCaseManagementConferenceDate
                ,eventPreMeetingDate
                ,eventProofsOfEvidenceDate
                ,hasApplicationFee
                ,applicationFee
                ,applicationFeeReceivedDate
                ,eligibleForFeeRefund
                ,applicationFeeRefundAmount
                ,applicationFeeRefundDate
                ,siteVisitDate
                ,cilLiable
                ,cilAmount
                ,bngExempt
                ,hasCostsApplications
                ,costsApplicationsComment
                ,environmentalImpactAssessment
                ,developmentPlan
                ,rightOfWay
                ,ODTSourceSystem
                ,SourceSystemID
                ,IngestionDate
                ,message_id
                ,ValidTo
                ,MD5(CONCAT(
                    IFNULL(CAST(id AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(casework_fact_key AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(caseReference AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(createdDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(updatedDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(type AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(subType AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(linkedParentId AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(description AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(primaryPINSLPACode AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(secondaryPINSLPACode AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(hasAgent AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(organisations AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(site_address_dim_key AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(siteAddressLine1 AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(siteAddressLine2 AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(siteAddressTownCity AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(siteAddressCounty AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(siteAddressPostcode AS STRING), '.')

                   ,IFNULL(CAST(siteArea AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(expectedDateOfSubmission AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(applicationStatus AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(applicationStage AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(nationallyImportant AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(nationallyImportantConfirmationDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(notNationallyImportantEmailSent AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(containsDistressingContent AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(lpaReference AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(category AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(isGreenBelt AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(healthAndSafetyIssue AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(applicationReceivedDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(applicationReceivedDateEmailSent AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(applicationAcceptedDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(lpaQuestionnaireSentDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(lpaQuestionnaireReceivedDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(lpaQuestionnaireReceivedEmailSent AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(publishDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(pressNoticeDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(neighboursNotifiedByLpaDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(siteNoticeByLpaDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(targetDecisionDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(extendedTargetDecisionDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(recoveredDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(recoveredReportSentDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(withdrawnDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(decisionDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(originalDecisionDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(decisionOutcome AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(turnedAwayDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(representationsPublishDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(representationsPeriodStartDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(representationsPeriodEndDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(inspector1Id AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(inspector2Id AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(inspector3Id AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(assessorInspectorId AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(caseOfficerId AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(planningOfficerId AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(eiaScreening AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(eiaScreeningOutcome AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(environmentalStatementReceivedDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(siteIsVisibleFromPublicLand AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(procedure AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(procedureNotificationDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(eventDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(eventPrepDuration AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(eventSittingDuration AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(eventReportingDuration AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(eventVenue AS STRING), '.')

                   ,IFNULL(CAST(siteVisitDate AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(cilLiable AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(cilAmount AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(bngExempt AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(hasCostsApplications AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(costsApplicationsComment AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(environmentalImpactAssessment AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(developmentPlan AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(rightOfWay AS STRING), '.')
                   ,IFNULL(CAST(IngestionDate AS STRING), '.')

                )) AS RowID
                ,IsActive
            FROM vw_applications
        """)

    except Exception as e:
        error_message = (
            f"Error in preparing results dataframe for {spark_table_final}: {str(e)[:800]}"
        )
        end_exec_time = datetime.now()
        print(error_message)
##### Ingest final data set to delta table applications_crowndev_application

if not error_message:
    try:
        insert_count = final_df.count()

        final_df.write \
            .format("delta") \
            .mode("overwrite") \
            .option("overwriteSchema", "true") \
            .partitionBy("IsActive") \
            .saveAsTable(spark_table_final)

        end_exec_time = datetime.now()

    except Exception as e:
        error_message = (
            f"Error in ingesting delta table {spark_table_final}: "
            f"{str(e)[:800]}"
        )
        end_exec_time = datetime.now()
        print(error_message)

duration_seconds = (end_exec_time - start_exec_time).total_seconds()
activity_type = f"{mssparkutils.runtime.context['currentNotebookName']} Notebook"
stage = "Success" if not error_message else "Failed"
status_message = (
    f"Successfully loaded data into {spark_table_final} table"
    if not error_message
    else f"Failed to load data from {spark_table_final} table"
)
status_code = "200" if stage == "Success" else "500"
 
log_telemetry_and_exit(
    stage,
    start_exec_time,
    end_exec_time,
    error_message,
    spark_table_final,
    insert_count,
    update_count,
    delete_count,
    PipelineName,
    PipelineRunID,
    PipelineTriggerID,
    PipelineTriggerName,
    PipelineTriggerType,
    PipelineTriggeredbyPipelineName,
    PipelineTriggeredbyPipelineRunID,
    activity_type,
    duration_seconds,
    status_message,
    status_code
